mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rate_plan_promotions (id, organization_id, hotel_id, rate_plan_id, code, name, promotion_type, discount_percent, priority, stay_start, stay_end, book_start, book_end, min_advance_days, max_advance_days, min_nights, days_of_week, status, data_version, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{hotelId}, #{ratePlanId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{promotionType}, #{discountPercent}, #{priority}, #{stayStart}, #{stayEnd}, #{bookStart}, #{bookEnd}, #{minAdvanceDays}, #{maxAdvanceDays}, #{minNights}, #{daysOfWeek}::jsonb, #{status}, #{dataVersion}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM rate_plan_promotions WHERE id=#{id} AND hotel_id=#{hotelId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rate_plan_promotions WHERE hotel_id=#{hotelId} AND status='ENABLED' AND (rate_plan_id IS NULL OR rate_plan_id=#{ratePlanId}) AND (stay_start IS NULL OR stay_start < #{checkOut}) AND (stay_end IS NULL OR stay_end >= #{checkIn}) AND (book_start IS NULL OR book_start <= #{bookedOn}) AND (book_end IS NULL OR book_end >= #{bookedOn}) ORDER BY discount_percent DESC, priority ASC, created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE rate_plan_promotions SET status='ARCHIVED', data_version=data_version+1, updated_by=#{actor}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE rate_plan_id=#{ratePlanId} AND status <> 'ARCHIVED'
